title: Christmas Bundle Clipart
author: Blueberry Hill Art
description:
Christmas bundle graphics, Christmas clipart set, Christmas graphics, Bundle Christmas clipart – Holidays designs – Christmas Season – Christmas design – Christmas clip art – Craft Supplies & Tools, Clip Art for Printing
 WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE :
This listing is for 6 instant download digital / electronic sharp, clear, crisp high-quality files in these types :
* 1 SVG -for Silhouette Designer Edition, Cricut Explore, Corel Draw, Adobe Suite, Inkspace
* 1 DXF – for Silhouette users
* 1 EPS – for Adobe Illustrator, Corel Draw, Inkspace
* 1 PDF – for Photoshop, Acrobat reader
* 1 JPG – for Photoshop, Acrobat reader
* 1 PNG – Transparent Background for web
NOTE! * The images are not separated in different files – all designs are in one file.
PERFECT FOR :
Cutting, overlays, scrapbooking, printed paper products, paper crafts, card making Stickers, Invitations, Party tags, hand-cut applique, embroidery, Digitized applique, Web Design, photo overlays on social media, framed clip art, Photo for home decor, mugs, wood sign stencil, vinyl decal, altered art and any creative projects decorations and activities, collage or decoupage.
It also can be used for transfer printing to fabrics, transfer paper or for transfer onto wood. You can print it to iron-on fabric transfer paper, and transfer the image to t-shirts, fabric and burlap pillows, tote bags, tea towels.
These cutting files can be used with many different cutting software/machines as Cricut Design Space, Silhouette Studio, Silhouette Studio Designer, Make the Cut, Sure Cuts A Lot.
NOTE: NOT a tangible item [ a physical copy ] is not included. Files will be delivered electronically.
NO custom (design) changes are included in the listing price.
This is not a finished product – only design files.
I check all my files in a few Cutting programs to make sure they work properly.
You need to have experience with these files.
Please ensure before purchase that the files will work with your cutting machine and do you have the proper software.
You may resize the files.
You may change the colors and sizes using your software at home.
All letters are vectorized / not TTF – true type files / and can not be used to type out on the keyboard.
Watermark free – the watermark and logo will not appear on your image.
INSTANT DOWNLOAD (ZIP FILE) :
You should download these files yourself – I will not be shipping anything to you so no waiting for me to send it out.
Please note that you will receive the set as a download link- ZIP file, and you will need software – programs such as WinRAR, WinZip, or 7zip to open/ unzip archived files.
Please make sure you have the required software and knowledge to use these graphics before you purchase.
Once you download the zip file, simply extract, and use the files.
Please feel free to convo me for any concerns, questions, custom orders. I will do my best to answer any questions you may have prior to buying your item. I don’t want you to be disappointed or surprised by anything.
I welcome your comments and love to know that you’re using the project!
